$comment: Branding overlay rules for mold_v1. The mold snapshot under codebase/ is never edited; branding.py copies it per app and applies these rules to the copy. Every rule must match at least once or the build is refused, so a mold refresh that moves this text fails loudly instead of shipping half-branded. Since upstream #15 the product name, tagline and description come from the deployment profile: branding.py writes profiles/90-brand.json and skips the rules marked via_profile and the product_name_files list; they remain for molds without a profile. The rule that rewrote the original layout description is gone: that literal left the source with upstream #15, and only a profiled mold is stamped.

replacements.find: The operations console for forward-deployed teams.
